title: kerf.json
description: A KerfScript project or library: its name and version, and the shared libraries its designs use. See https://kerfscript.mylasertools.com/docs/shared-libraries/

name.description: The library's name. Designs load its files with use <name/...>.

version.description: The library's version, like 1.2.0. Raise the first number when a module's parameters change or existing designs would cut differently.

description.description: One line on what the library makes.

license.description: The licence others may use the library under.

language.description: The oldest KerfScript language version the library works with, like 0.1.

libraries.description: The libraries this project uses: name to source. A source is github:owner/repo@tag, an https:// link to a .tar.gz, or a folder like ./my-library. Run kerf install after a change.
